note: Release supply-chain hardening. Every release now ships CycloneDX SBOMs and signed GitHub artifact attestations. The release job (main only, after all gates) records SLSA build provenance for the published .crate files (checked against the crates.io checksum), the vespera-bridge / Gradle plugin JARs (main, sources, javadoc) and the SBOMs, plus one CycloneDX SBOM attestation per package; verify with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo dev-five-git/vespera` (see SECURITY.md). kr.devfive:vespera-bridge publishes its SBOM to Maven Central as the `cyclonedx` classifier (vespera-bridge-<version>-cyclonedx.json); the crate and Gradle plugin SBOMs are attached to the GitHub releases (the Plugin Portal rejects JSON artifacts). New SECURITY.md with private vulnerability reporting. No API change.
